objective: Close Phase 9 item C28: the tasks of odd/tasks/phase9-c28-review-precision.md, so that each of the 158 findings our review returned in C27's 30 runs over R34-R43 is labeled real, false or unsure by a blind judge, checked by the parent's sample, and the precision of our review is recorded.
scope: The specs S1-S6 of odd/tasks/phase9-c28-review-precision.md; one workflow and one role chain for each task.
constraints: The builder builds only a task the shaper designed.
The findings are frozen into the repository before any rerun of run-ours.sh (S2).
The judge never sees the runner, the row, the run, the severity, the score or the defect, and reads a tree with no git history (S3).
The parent's sample is committed before any judge is launched, and the parent never edits a judge's label (S5).
Every commit is reviewed or exempted, and labdrian review check clears it.
non_goals: Changing the reviewer body, the preamble, the rows, the role chain or engine code.
A pass/fail bar the owner has not set.
acceptance_criteria: T1-T4 of odd/tasks/phase9-c28-review-precision.md are checked off, each with its commit.
The Log holds the result entry of S6 with the agreement and control of S5.
labdrian review check --onto main clears the head of each task's pull request.
runtime_scope: Claude Code, as the parent that runs the labdrian workflow and the role agents.
delivery_boundary: Work-unit commits on the branches of odd/tasks/phase9-c28-review-precision.md; push, pull requests and merges remain the owner's decisions under ordinary repository policy.
